arms.D: aligned template-field semantic route and frozen Fiber-CTS integer probability
arms.G: one physical eligible-byte timeline with identical context geometry and update count
arms.S: immediately preceding completed field route with identical eligibility and state geometry

input_visibility: Open only a verified immutable semantic-route tape and scope manifest.
Reveal a tape record only when its physical coder-decision coordinate is reached.

Do not consult the descriptor sidecar, future records, future coordinates, field exit, future value length, truth bit, or q1 parent probability before emitting all arm probabilities for the current decision.
Consume the truth bit only after the pretruth probability row and rolling state digest are committed.
Update every arm in its isolated state after truth using the frozen Fiber-CTS order.

probability_trace.fields: uint64 coder-decision coordinate, five uint16 D/G/S/R/N probabilities, uint8 truth, uint8 awake mask, uint64 canonical raw coordinate, and uint32 preregistered stratum code
probability_trace.probability_domain: uint16 count for bit one in [1,65535] over total 65536
probability_trace.timing_proof: A source-bound use-def audit and pretruth rolling transcript must prove that the five probability fields are fixed before the truth byte is read.
probability_trace.sleep: An arm asleep at a coordinate clears its awake bit and emits no value claim; the Atlas must not count the row for that arm.
probability_trace.repeat: A fresh process reproduces every trace byte, arm-state digest, opportunity count, stratum count, and resource summary.
